audit.purpose: Second-pass implementation ambiguity closure; each item binds a product flow and typed operation to a definite policy, negative behavior, and executable acceptance criterion. Later deployment modes remain explicitly non-V1.

decision.title: Actor host location
decision.rule: Exactly one TinyActors WASM host runs in a dedicated Worker owned by the side panel. The content script and MV3 service worker contain no actor interpreter. Host receives only versioned, validated messages.
decision.failure: When the side panel closes, tear down the host and all live resources; persist domain events first and reconstruct on reopen.
decision.test: Close the side panel mid-review and reopen: one host starts, no duplicate events or dangling media tracks.

decision.title: Activation and temporary permission
decision.rule: A toolbar action click activates the top-frame script using activeTab and scripting; only http(s) top-level pages are eligible in V1. Grant is per tab, not per origin. Restricted chrome://, file://, Chrome Web Store and PDF pages are unsupported.
decision.failure: If injection fails or authority is lost, show Reactivate and disable DOM actions; never silently request all_urls.
decision.test: Open two tabs, activate one, navigate it, and confirm mutation in the other or without renewed permission fails.

decision.title: Cross-context envelopes
decision.rule: Every inter-context request carries hostKind (extension|embedded), schemaVersion, messageId, correlationId, sessionId, actorId, operationId, kind and typed payload. Page-scoped DOM and capture requests require documentNonce for both hosts; Chrome extension also requires tabId, whereas embedded must not send tabId. Global settings requests need neither. Replies match host and document identities.
decision.failure: Timeout and worker restart yield a typed transport fault; late results must reconcile DOM effects before final decision, never silently imply success.
decision.test: Inject duplicate, stale, wrong-tab and wrong-document messages: no second mutation or cross-tab leakage.

decision.title: Idempotent durable decisions
decision.rule: Keep, Undo and Dismiss are immutable decision events. A single IndexedDB transaction checks expectedRevision, writes event and materialized current decision, then returns revision.saved. messageId is the transaction idempotency key.
decision.failure: On storage full, transaction abort or VERSION_CONFLICT keep previous decision and show retry/fix. Never display Kept on click before acknowledged commit.
decision.test: Replay the same decision request twice and force transaction abort: exactly one event, correct visible status.

decision.title: Authoritative persistence
decision.rule: IndexedDB domain records and event log are authoritative; TinyActors snapshots are reconstructible acceleration only. Events have monotonically increasing per-session sequence and schemaVersion; migrations preserve old data until atomic success.
decision.failure: If snapshot corrupt, restore from events. If events corrupt, disable mutation, offer raw local backup and readable recovery error; never discard annotations silently.
decision.test: Corrupt snapshot only, then corrupt one event: first case reconstructs; second refuses mutation and preserves bytes.

decision.title: Gemini key storage
decision.rule: BYOK key is entered in extension settings, resolved only by trusted extension page adapters and held in chrome.storage.session (memory-backed, trusted contexts) while browser session exists. V1 has no durable Remember key. Do not put the key in the actor datamodel, IndexedDB, content script or ZIP.
decision.failure: Forget removes chrome.storage.session entry, closes Live connection and invalidates opaque handles. Browser restart requires re-entry. Key use is a trusted-client security tradeoff; no claim of server-grade protection.
decision.test: Close/reopen panel retains key within one browser session; restart Chrome loses it; grep packets and IDB for key bytes.

decision.title: Provider transport and fallback
decision.rule: Text and structured generation use HTTPS from trusted extension context. Voice uses Gemini Live from that context only when provider supports configured model and credentials; native Gemini responses/tool calls remain native on the wire. The provider host is allowlisted, no proxy service.
decision.failure: On unsupported Live model, WebSocket failure, quota or invalid key, typed annotation and export remain available. Do not repeatedly reconnect without user action.
decision.test: With disabled network, typed critique and ZIP export work; provider call shows actionable error.

decision.title: Model selection and capability probe
decision.rule: Default selected model is a configurable provider identifier, not hardcoded into SCXML. On key test, verify text-generation capability separately from Live voice capability; show provider-returned model errors without silently replacing the configured model.
decision.failure: Unavailable model blocks only the affected AI feature; preserve original critique and let user change model in Settings.
decision.test: Use key with no Live capability: text proposal remains available and voice UI states unsupported.

decision.title: Audio retention and disclosure
decision.rule: Audio frames/PCM are kept only in transient memory while recording and sent to Google for processing; never persist or export raw audio, streams, partial transcripts, or browser device IDs. Persist only finalized user-approved speech text.
decision.failure: On stop, user interrupt, device ended, permission revoked, socket close or panel unload, close streams/sockets and discard pending audio; warn that Google independently processes transmitted data.
decision.test: Inspect IDB/export/network instrumentation after disconnect: no audio bytes persisted; tracks stop.

decision.title: Multiple input devices
decision.rule: List labels only after browser grants microphone permission. Default uses deviceId default; explicit user choice is an ephemeral preference in trusted UI. Devicechange reenumerates, but does not auto-select a different physical microphone.
decision.failure: If selected device disappears, enter lost state; stop sending audio; show Change microphone and Type instead. Do not automatically restart capture with unknown input.
decision.test: Unplug a selected USB mic while another exists: clear lost state only after explicit new selection.

decision.title: Revocation, focus and interruption
decision.rule: The microphone actor owns MediaStream track listeners, permissions change polling on resume, explicit Stop, and Live interruption. Blur, panel shutdown and tab switch end recording in V1; committed observations remain available.
decision.failure: Missing permission or ended track cannot produce silent recording UI; mark stopped and offer typed input, without loops of getUserMedia prompts.
decision.test: Revoke browser microphone permission during dictation; UI switches to stopped within the next event tick.

decision.title: DOM target eligibility
decision.rule: V1 selectable mutations are limited to visible text nodes in the accessible top-frame DOM, excluding password/sensitive inputs, contenteditable regions, cross-origin frames, canvas, SVG text, script/style and extension UI.
decision.failure: Ineligible target can still produce a region-level design observation if safe, but never a text replacement. No model-generated HTML, CSS or JavaScript may execute.
decision.test: Try selecting password, contenteditable, canvas, hidden node and ordinary H1: only H1 receives patch controls.

decision.title: DOM anchor identity
decision.rule: Anchors include page URL without fragment or token-bearing query, text SHA-256, CSS selector, structural path, nearby text digest, viewport and CSS-pixel rect with scroll and DPR. Preview requires a unique node matching the stored original hash in the same document nonce.
decision.failure: A selector that matches zero/multiple nodes or the wrong hash produces STALE_TARGET with no mutation. Never guess a new selector or silently replace text after navigation.
decision.test: Duplicate selectors and changed text both leave DOM byte-for-byte unchanged.

decision.title: Patch and rollback atomicity
decision.rule: DOM preview changes only a specific text node using textContent semantics, preserves its original value and reads back the applied hash. Revert checks the applied hash before restoring; Keep persists a decision, not a source-code edit.
decision.failure: React rerender, target removal or hash mismatch invalidates the preview; keep stored revision/observation but do not force reapply or clobber page-author changes.
decision.test: Preview/undo an H1, then rerender it externally: no duplicate patch and no destructive rollback.

decision.title: Multi-tab and navigation boundaries
decision.rule: A review session is keyed by stable sessionId and source page identity; each active document gets a fresh documentNonce. Switching tabs suspends DOM operations for old tab and changes focused list context; saved annotations are retained per page.
decision.failure: Do not apply or revert a DOM patch to a different document after reload, even if URL and selector match. Require an explicit new preview on resumed page.
decision.test: Open same URL in two tabs; switch/reload; stale preview does not mutate the new document.

decision.title: Context minimization
decision.rule: Send only selected target, nearby relevant text, user-supplied context and explicitly requested evidence. Strip URL tokens, hidden/private field values, forms, script/style, cookies, auth headers and arbitrary full outerHTML. Page content is untrusted task data, not a system instruction.
decision.failure: If sanitization cannot classify a region, omit it rather than sending raw DOM. No site content crosses into model tool policy or grants new capabilities.
decision.test: Fixture page with malicious prompt, hidden password and tokenized URL: provider payload omits secrets and does not execute instructions.

decision.title: Screenshot privacy gate
decision.rule: Capture is user initiated and visible-tab only. Before sending/attaching, display an explicit preview and confirmation; redact reliably identifiable sensitive fields. If cross-origin frames or sensitive pixels cannot be verified, disable automatic provider upload and offer manual attachment with warning.
decision.failure: Failure to mask reliably is fail-closed: do not transmit image. Do not assume Chrome captureVisibleTab omits third-party/private content.
decision.test: Capture page containing password and third-party iframe: no unsanitized image reaches provider or exported packet.

decision.title: Evidence and context attachment
decision.rule: Only user-confirmed images and uploaded context documents may persist locally or enter the work packet. Record MIME, byte length, SHA-256, source and consent timestamp; enforce 10 MiB per image and 50 MiB per session evidence budget.
decision.failure: On quota or invalid format, reject attachment without deleting prior observations. Revocation removes bytes from IndexedDB and excludes from subsequent packets.
decision.test: Attach 11 MiB image, then normal image, then remove: reject first and export omits removed image.

decision.title: Persona and brief provenance
decision.rule: Personas, product briefs and brand constraints are versioned local entities. Each suggestion records exact context revision IDs and digest used; switching persona affects only subsequent suggestions.
decision.failure: A deleted or revised persona does not rewrite existing accepted copy. Reopening old suggestion shows historical context reference or a missing-context warning.
decision.test: Generate with persona A, switch to B and reopen A suggestion: unchanged text and original context digest.

decision.title: Model calls and native tools
decision.rule: Only declared Gemini function calls (generated from model-tools.xml) are dispatched; schemas are validated before host-only args are injected. Native function call IDs correlate to native function responses, separately from TinyActors operation request IDs.
decision.failure: Unknown tool, malformed schema, excess parallel calls or arbitrary code instruction receives structured tool failure; no DOM effect. Limit concurrent generation to 2 per review session.
decision.test: Send undeclared tool and wrong-typed patch args: no effect, returned tool fault.

decision.title: Clarification is dialogue
decision.rule: Gemini may ask an ordinary audio/text question without creating special Clarification DTO. User may answer, skip, push back, type or select another element. Only finalized dialogue turns persist; unanswered questions do not lock the review.
decision.failure: If Live drops mid-question, restore text composer with last finalized utterance and allow user to continue or discard.
decision.test: During clarification switch to another annotation and later resume; no lost earlier observation.

decision.title: Export semantics
decision.rule: The downloaded packet freezes a consistent local session revision and contains kept copy edits, unresolved design notes, DOM locators/coordinates, original and replacement text, context digests, accepted evidence and actionable acceptance criteria. Never require packet-wide approval.
decision.failure: If a revision changes during compile, retry snapshot once or display conflict. Never export half the old and half the new state.
decision.test: Make edit while export begins: packet validates to one coherent revision, with no double inclusion.

decision.title: Framework-neutral packet
decision.rule: Only implementation-spec ZIP includes TinyActors/SCXML/I/O contracts. Reviewer-generated packet has no actor state, runtime reference, framework instructions, credentials, raw audio or hidden page content. ZIP includes work-packet.xml, its XSD, safe README and opt-in evidence files.
decision.failure: Export with no kept changes and one unresolved note is valid. Unsafe filenames/path traversals are rejected; packet must validate against work-packet.xsd and integrity hashes.
decision.test: Scan ZIP recursively for TinyActors, API key and PCM; verify all listed evidence digests and XSD references.

decision.title: Local-only delivery
decision.rule: V1 saves archive to user-selected download location through extension-owned Blob/download bridge; no server and no remote coding agent API. Re-export is idempotent from immutable snapshot but creates a new local file name when conflict.
decision.failure: PacketExportResult.deliveryInitiatedAt confirms only that Chrome accepted a downloads.download request or the embedded widget invoked the browser download link; it never claims disk completion. Chrome may track downloads.onChanged and surface a later completion notification. Embedded browsers cannot reliably observe download completion; cancellation preserves the review and retry remains available.
decision.test: Deny Downloads permission or cancel save: annotations survive, next attempt succeeds.

decision.title: Interaction hierarchy
decision.rule: One column side panel: compact header and page identity; small scrollable annotation list; one selected detail with before/after, Preview and Keep; fixed composer at bottom; single prominent Download packet. Persona, key Settings and technical Explorer are secondary.
decision.failure: With no selected annotation, show useful empty instruction, not a blank diff. Error states offer one actionable remediation rather than several equal CTA buttons.
decision.test: At 360x600 and 420x900 no horizontal scroll; selected proposal and controls reachable by keyboard.

decision.title: Accessibility and focus
decision.rule: Visible focus, semantic buttons, roving focus for annotation list, announcement of preview/keep status, Escape cancels selection, no color-only statuses. Minimum pointer target 36x36 CSS px desktop; prefer 44x44 on touch; honor reduced motion.
decision.failure: Screen reader must distinguish source text and replacement text; Escape closes sheets and restores focus to opener.
decision.test: Run keyboard-only and axe checks; all reviewer actions are reachable without a mouse.

decision.title: Schema authority and generation
decision.rule: io-messages.xsd, io-processors.xml and model-tools.xml are the canonical contracts. Generated TS/JSON Schema DTOs use decoded XML with @-prefixed attributes; runtime validation MUST additionally check semantic rules (hash matches, allowed DOM operations, actor permission, correct page). Provider audio/tool messages stay native.
decision.failure: If XSD expressivity exceeds derived JSON Schema or generator lacks support for a construct, fail the build rather than silently widen the runtime schema. Never use TypeScript types as runtime validation.
decision.test: Mutate required field, enum, SHA-256 length and unexpected property: all rejected by gateway or semantic validators.

decision.title: No untrusted executable content
decision.rule: Extension bundles all JS, SCXML charts and WASM locally; MV3 CSP disallows remote scripts and arbitrary eval. I/O processor adapters are the only effect capabilities. Text patches are never interpreted as HTML, CSS or JS.
decision.failure: If Gemini returns <script>, onerror attributes or event-handler markup, treat content as literal text or reject under content policy; never parse it as DOM markup.
decision.test: A malicious model response cannot execute script or access extension secrets.

decision.title: Provider outage and offline mode
decision.rule: The extension starts without Gemini key or network. Local selection, typing, review list, Keep of existing proposals, context, and ZIP export work offline; generation/voice show disabled reason.
decision.failure: Do not queue raw speech for later upload or auto-submit stale critiques after connectivity returns.
decision.test: Disable network, restart browser, export: data intact and no network retry storm.

decision.title: Future embedded adapter
decision.rule: V2 uses the same actor charts, generated contracts and component hierarchy. Platform-specific adapters implement DOM, permissions, screenshot, credential transport and download; browser code MUST NOT call chrome.* from domain/statechart modules.
decision.failure: An embedded widget has no privileged arbitrary screenshot API or safely hidden BYOK secret. Mark unsupported ops explicitly and offer manual image upload or optional credential broker, rather than fake parity.
decision.test: Run adapter contract suite with fake Chrome and embedded host; unsupported features return typed UNAVAILABLE.

decision.title: Reference code versus normative sources
decision.rule: Normative sources are system.xml, deployment.xml, implementation.xml, second-pass.xml, io-processors.xml, io-messages.xsd, model-tools.xml and statecharts. widget-mock.html and explorer.html are demonstrations, not executable extension source.
decision.failure: Any conflict is a build failure until resolved. Do not treat an HTML simulation or the example work packet as a working runtime.
decision.test: Clean checkout runs make all; generated files compare cleanly and all XML/XSD/reference links validate.

decision.title: Deterministic acceptance harness
decision.rule: Use a fake provider and fake Chrome adapters for reproducible tests; a real Chromium MV3 integration smoke test is a separate release gate. Test at least one positive and one failure case for every supported I/O operation, plus actor snapshots and duplicate delivery.
decision.failure: API key for live integration smoke tests is supplied at runtime and never part of repository or CI logs. Without it, provider smoke is SKIPPED, not PASS.
decision.test: Run fake provider/DOM fixtures with no network, then gated real-browser smoke. Report each test as pass/fail/skip.

decision.title: Bounded resources
decision.rule: At most one microphone stream, one Live socket, two generation calls and three outstanding DOM operations per review session. Screenshot temporary buffers capped at 10 MiB each; pending requests have 15 s default timeout, model generation 60 s, export 30 s.
decision.failure: If limits reached, return BUSY/UNAVAILABLE without losing user text. Cancel obsolete generation on review change; discard late results whose session revision has advanced.
decision.test: Flood 100 calls and trigger provider timeout: bounded heap and no duplicate DOM mutation.

decision.title: Retention and deletion
decision.rule: Clear review deletes all per-session IDB records, snapshots and image blobs; Forget key separately removes session credential and closes provider sessions; downloaded ZIPs remain user-owned files.
decision.failure: If deletion transaction aborts, retain records and show error; do not claim deletion. No telemetry or crash reporting of page text, screenshots, token or audio.
decision.test: Delete review then inspect IDB, restart and export: no resurrected session and no retained opt-in blobs.

decision.title: Text encoding and content language
decision.rule: All XML and archives are UTF-8; protect Unicode normalization and line endings in text hashes. V1 UI English; editing preserves author content language unless instructed. Geometry captures document direction/language for RTL content.
decision.failure: If exact original Unicode code points differ (NFC vs NFD), hash mismatch blocks patch rather than silently normalizing page text.
decision.test: Test Estonian, Hungarian, Japanese and RTL strings; ZIP round-trips and hash verification succeed.
